cohort: 469 patients with endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium
finding: Lower uterine segment involvement is associated with an increased risk of recurrence in patients with stage IA endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium who underwent a laparoscopic/robotic surgical approach.
mod_finding: Patients with lower uterine segment involvement undergoing laparoscopic/robotic surgery had higher recurrence rates.
